infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Gracerandly uses your camera for video calls with your requester/runner.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Gracerandly uses your microphone for voice notes and calls.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Gracerandly needs your location to match you with nearby errands and confirm pickup/delivery.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Gracerandly needs your location in the background so requesters can track your progress on an errand.

plugins.photosPermission: Gracerandly uses your photos to set your profile picture.
plugins.cameraPermission: Gracerandly uses your camera to take a profile picture.

plugins.microphonePermission: Gracerandly uses your microphone for voice notes and calls.
